line: Prabhu, main Vrishabh walon ki wakeel hun, aur mera client 2026 se naraaz hai.
Naraaz hai ya bhookha, wakeel saahiba? Vrishabh walon ka gussa toh aksar achhe khaane se hi utarta hai.
Office mein roz naya drama hota tha, aur ghar pe chain ki neend nahi milti thi.
Par Shani dev toh labh wale gyarahve ghar mein the. Office Rahu ne dasve ghar se hilaya, aur sukoon Ketu ne chauthe se liya.
Lekin ek second!
Matlab kamaai bhi hui aur chain bhi gaya, ye kaisa hisaab hai?
Isiliye toh mol-bhaav ho raha hai. Bolo, 2027 mein kya chahiye?
Abhi maza aayega na bhidu!
Pehli demand ye hai ki office ka drama band ho.
Paanch December ko Rahu dasve se nauve ghar mein jaayenge, toh office ka shor kam hone ki ummeed hai, par kismat pe koi bada daav mat lagana.
Doosri demand, mere client ko ghar mein sukoon chahiye.
Usi din Ketu chauthe ghar se niklenge. Guru abhi wahin hain, January ke aakhir mein thoda hatenge, aur June se November tak wapas aayenge.
Ruko zara, sabar karo!
Toh ab mera client bhi bolega, mere paas ghar hai, sukoon hai, Guru hain!
Aur maa bhi hai, kyunki chautha ghar maa ka hi hota hai.
Teesri demand ye hai ki pyaar aur bachchon ki good news bhi aaye.
Uske liye saal ke aakhir tak rukna hoga, jab chhabbees November 2027 ko Guru paanchve ghar, yaani pyaar aur bachchon ke ghar mein aayenge.
Aur last demand, Sade Sati ko bas ek saal aage khiska dijiye.

Wo Shani dev ka vibhag hai, wahan sifaarish nahi chalti. Teen June 2027 se Sade Sati ka pehla charan shuru hoga, October se February tak break milega, aur 23 February 2028 se wahi charan phir chalega.
Hey Bhagwan, kya karun main!
Aur aapka client ek baar commitment kar de toh khud ki bhi nahi sunta, toh June se pehle mehnat aur bachat ka commitment karo, kyunki baarahva ghar kharchon ka hai.
Jaate jaate ek tohfa lo, aapke swami Shukra dev 2027 mein ek baar bhi vakri nahi honge, toh aaraam aur sundar cheezon ka maza bina atke milega.
Toh faisla aa gaya: kaam ko kam shor, ghar ko Guru ka saath, rishton ko November, aur Sade Sati ko bachat aur mehnat. Touchwood to Vrishabh!
2027 ko manifest karna hai toh link pe click karo, aur ye video usko bhejo jisse apna 2027 jaanna hai.
